data.title: Arim
data.about:
Arim by Alef Group at Sharjah is an integral part of the exclusive Hayyan community. This development showcases 2 to 4-bedroom Arim Hayyan townhouses, 4 to 6-bedroom villas, and luxurious 7-bedroom mansions. Each modern home at Arim in Hayyan Area features spacious living areas designed for comfort and sophistication.

Homes in Arim at Sharjah developed by Alef Group come with premium kitchens fitted with built-in appliances from renowned international brands. Additional features include staff quarters, storage, laundry, and powder rooms. Select 4-bedroom villas, and all mansions offer private pools and terraces. Residences with 5 to 7 bedrooms include balconies, elevators, and leisure spaces with pools.

Arim by Alef Group for sale in Sharjah includes two-car garages for smaller homes and three-car garages for larger units. Arim by Alef Group amenities cater to luxury, combining modern comfort with traditional design. Flexible Arim by Alef Group payment plans are available.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prestigious Development: Arim by Alef Group at Sharjah combines modern luxury with traditional elegance.
  • Diverse Property Options: The community offers a range of 2—to 4-bedroom townhouses, 4-—to 6-bedroom villas, and 7-bedroom mansions.
  • Premium Amenities: Equipped with top-tier kitchens, private pools, terraces, and leisure spaces.
  • Family-Friendly Environment: Features spacious living areas and staff quarters for convenience and comfort.
  • Vibrant Community: Located in the exclusive Hayyan community with lush greenery and recreational facilities.
  • Prime Location: Close to Sharjah International Airport, National Park, and educational institutions within a short drive.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: Attractive payment options are available for potential homeowners

location_tile.title: Where Urban Convenience Meets Serene Living in the Heart of Sharjah
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: Arim by Alef Group at Sharjah boasts a prime location with excellent connectivity along Emirates Road. Residents enjoy easy access to Sharjah International Airport and Sharjah National Park, both just 10 minutes away. Sharjah University City is a quick 15-minute drive. This area features luxurious infrastructure, including the largest public park, a vast swimming lagoon, and various sports facilities. Educational institutions and medical services, such as Emirates American School and Family Health Promotion Center, are conveniently located within a 10-15 minute drive. Explore modern homes at Arim in Hayyan Area, with attractive payment plans available for Arim by Alef Group for sale in Sharjah.
